CONTROLS.NAME: flashing
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn ON to cause the scene to flash on high percussive hits.

CONTROLS.NAME: monochrome
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn ON to force the scene to monochrome, which also effects the visual feedback. Try with a Media (and try inverting the image).

CONTROLS.NAME: extra_cols
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn ON to add in extra colors to any of the color palettes. Results in more saturated, noisy colors.

CONTROLS.NAME: pixelation
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Default is none. Increase this slider for a pixelation effect.

CONTROLS.NAME: feedback
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn up to increase the 'overload' feedback moments. Turn down to turn off overloaded feedback entirely.

CONTROLS.NAME: auto_blocks
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn ON to automatically have large blocky pixels change on beat.

CONTROLS.NAME: fresh_blocks
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Manually force blocks to change on press.
